commit_message: Implement ADR0135 native inference resource arbitration
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0135 native inference resource arbitration
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR0135 first-release native inference scheduling and Editor GPU resource arbitration on top of the existing ADR0131 Agent Host contract. Adds provider-independent workload/quality/resource planning, explicit backend resource capabilities, conservative telemetry, InferenceFocused presentation reclaim/restore, native inference interruption, persistent editing interruption/resume state with authoritative reinspection, renderer priority for Play/capture, and benchmark evidence plumbing.

## Safety

Preserves Stop as cancellation, keeps MCP/authoring authority unchanged, does not expose provider-specific raw GPU knobs, and does not move agent lifecycle into engine-renderer.
